mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no AS acmNo, a.accommodation_name AS acmName, a.accommodation_address AS acmAddress, a.accommodation_contents AS contents, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkout AS checkoutTime, a.tel AS acmTel, a.keyword_no AS keywordNo, a.business_no AS businessNo, a.category_no AS categoryNo, c.category_name AS categoryName, GROUP_CONCAT(m.amenities_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS amenitiesName FROM accommodation a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no LEFT JOIN accommodation_amenities am ON a.accommodation_no = am.accommodation_no LEFT JOIN amenities m ON am.amenities_no = m.amenities_no WHERE a.accommodation_no = #{acmNo} GROUP BY a.accommodation_no, c.category_name
SELECT r.image_no AS imageNo, r.filename AS filename, r.filepath AS filepath FROM room_image r WHERE r.accommodation_no = #{acmNo}

SELECT r.room_no as roomNo, r.accommodation_no as acmNo, r.room_name as roomName, r.room_qty as roomQty, r.room_price as roomPrice, r.room_discount as roomDiscount, r.room_contents as roomContents, r.room_viewtype as roomViewType, r.room_capacity as roomCapacity FROM room r JOIN accommodation a ON r.accommodation_no = a.accommodation_no WHERE r.accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
SELECT c.category_no, c.category_name FROM accommodation a JOIN category c ON a.category_no = c.category_no WHERE a.accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
SELECT k.keyword_no, k.keyword_name FROM accommodation a JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no WHERE a.accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
